sketches.mechanism: Move semantics: passing a non-Copy value transfers ownership, so using it again is a compile-time error.
sketches.resonance: A heart that has been given cannot be given a second time; the type system remembers the departure.

sketches.mechanism: EmptyCase over an uninhabited type: a function from an impossible value can return any type because it can never be called.
sketches.resonance: The absent one can promise every answer precisely because they will never arrive to answer.

sketches.mechanism: A receive expression with no message clauses and an infinity timeout suspends forever, accepting nothing and never reaching the timeout body.
sketches.resonance: Waiting becomes absolute when even the escape named timeout is made unreachable.
sketches.draft:
-module(still).
-export([wait/0]).

wait() ->
    receive
    after infinity -> wait()
    end.
